# netbox_virtual_circuit_types (Data Source)

Retrieves all virtual circuit types from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_virtual_circuit_types" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "name"
    value = "example"
  }
  limit = 10
}

output "virtual_circuit_types_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_virtual_circuit_types.example.virtual_circuit_types[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `virtual_circuit_types` (Attributes List) The virtual circuit types found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--virtual_circuit_types))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.

- `last_updated` (String) The last updated of the virtual circuit types.

- `virtual_circuit_count` (Number) The virtual circuit count of the virtual circuit types.
